units.source_text: 阿清年方十六七，就沦落到这深山里来，不久被弄坏了身子，就选定这个山村作为葬身之地。

en.t: Aqing was only sixteen or seventeen when she drifted into these deep mountains; before long her body was ruined, and she chose this mountain village as the place where she would die.

units.source_text: 男人们搂住这个轻生的姑娘，如同拥抱着一个苍白的幻影。

en.t: The men held this girl who had tried to throw her life away, as though they were embracing a pale apparition.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，她还经常遭到蹂躏。

en.t: Even so, she was still often violated.

units.source_text: 她一有空闲，就跟村里的幼儿戏耍作乐。

en.t: Whenever she had a little free time, she played and amused herself with the village children.
